## Checklist

- [ ] One file per source, in the right category folder (`docs/grants/`, `docs/publications/`, …)
- [ ] `entry_id` is unique and `title` doesn't clash with another page
- [ ] `status` is `candidate` for anything not ingested yet
- [ ] The source provides the required attributes of its entity (see the category page)
- [ ] `ingestion`, `storage` and `projects` / `candidate_projects` use existing ids
- [ ] Nothing internal copied from private repos (link to them instead)
